title: Hands-free job notes
desc: Dictate a note while your hands are covered in paint, and have it filed against the right job.

title: Log hours and materials
desc: Say what you used and how long it took, and have it recorded without touching a screen.

title: Ask about the day
desc: Ask for today's jobs, reminders and what is next, and hear the answer read back.

title: Reorder supplies by voice
desc: Say what ran out and get a link to reorder it from the store.

title: Only does what it is allowed to
desc: Designed to carry out a fixed list of allowed actions and to confirm before it changes anything.
